title: Root Certificate and Time-Varying Frame API
objective: Expose the complete fixed-plus-dynamic root as one typed, cacheable, auditable frame certificate.
negative_results: The certificate is a SOFTWARE_RESULT / CANDIDATE_CALIBRATED_POINT under a declared calibration — not a measured fact, and it validates no source origin.
resolve(epoch, shell) is deterministic and cached; the cache bucket does NOT erase the exact requested epoch/radius, which the certificate preserves.
Requests outside the SAA model validity return a typed RootRefusal (ResultClass.INVALID) via resolve_or_refuse, or raise SAAError via resolve.
Every input and derived basis vector (South-Up basis, root face-centre direction, SAA direction) is hashed.

claims.statement: The two-layer EARTH_ROOT_D_V1 root (Wilkes fixed + SAA dynamic at (epoch,shell) + South-Up orientation + face-centre root) is assembled as one hashed, cacheable, deterministic certificate.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public inputs only; no private reads, no personal names or paths.
